sentences.acceptance_bounded: An issue it closes is commented past what the Factory reads; a person checks it.
sentences.acceptance_evidence_missing: Waiting for passing evidence on every acceptance criterion of this version.
sentences.acceptance_failed: An acceptance criterion failed on this version; the author fixes the change.
sentences.acceptance_reporters_unreadable: Who may report acceptance results could not be read; a person checks why.
sentences.acceptance_unreadable: The acceptance contract or its results could not be read; a person checks why.
sentences.act_ceiling: The Factory has acted on it as often as allowed; a person decides whether it goes on.
sentences.acts_unreadable: The count of the Factory's acts on it could not be read; the Factory reads again.
sentences.approval_due: Every required check and review passed; the Factory approves it next.
sentences.approval_lost: Its approval no longer stands, so it leaves the merge queue to be approved again.
sentences.approved: Approved; the Factory adds it to the merge queue.
sentences.approver_is_author_or_last_pusher: The Factory's approver wrote or last pushed it, so its approval would not count; a person decides.
sentences.attempts_exhausted: Its runs failed as often as allowed; a person decides whether to try again.
sentences.awaiting_checks: Waiting for the required checks to finish.
sentences.awaiting_human: An open review thread waits for a person to answer it.
sentences.awaiting_review: Waiting for a reviewer to review this version.
sentences.base_not_protected: The branch it targets is not protected, so the Factory does not serve it.
sentences.capacity: The model provider asked the Factory to wait; it tries again later.
sentences.capacity_unreadable: How much the Factory may run now could not be read; it reads again.
sentences.check_failed: A required check failed; the author fixes the change.
sentences.check_unreadable: A required check gave no result or came from the wrong source; a person checks why.
sentences.closed: Closed without a merge; the Factory does nothing more.
sentences.concurrency: The Factory is running as many jobs as it may; it waits for one to end.
sentences.conflict: It conflicts with the branch it targets; the author resolves the conflict.
sentences.contract_changed: The acceptance contract changed after a person approved it; a person approves it again.
sentences.contract_not_approved: The acceptance contract has no standing approval by a person; a person approves it.
sentences.description_edited_after_approval: The description changed after the approval; a person reads it and approves again.
sentences.description_unreadable: When the description was last edited could not be read; a person checks why.
sentences.draft: A draft; the Factory waits until it is marked ready for review.
sentences.empty_diff: It changes no files, so there is nothing to review; a person decides.
sentences.environment_ceiling: Its runs failed to start as often as allowed; a person decides whether to try again.
sentences.facts_incomplete: Some facts about it could not be read whole; the Factory reads again.
sentences.findings_open: A reviewer's finding is open; the author addresses it.
sentences.gate_open: An open review thread takes it out of the merge queue; it is addressed first.
sentences.hands_off: A person marked it hands-off; the Factory leaves it alone.
sentences.human_finding: A person's review thread is open; the author addresses it.
sentences.human_hold: A hold label is on it; it waits until a person removes the label.
sentences.in_merge_queue: In the merge queue; it merges once the queue's checks pass.
sentences.issue_stands_unreadable: Whether its issue is open could not be read; a person checks why.
sentences.issue_stopped: Its issue is held or closed, so it is held too; a person decides.
sentences.label_unreadable: Who placed or removed its labels could not be read; a person checks why.
sentences.last_pusher_unreadable: Who pushed it last could not be read; a person checks why.
sentences.max_rounds: Its findings went through as many rounds of rulings as allowed; a person decides.
sentences.mergeable_unreadable: GitHub has not yet worked out whether it merges cleanly; the Factory reads again.
sentences.merged: Merged; the Factory does nothing more.
sentences.model_lens_input_needs_person: It changes what a model reviewer reads, so a person approves it as well.
sentences.outside_not_admitted: Opened from outside the Factory and not admitted; a person decides whether it is taken.
sentences.path_needs_person: It changes a file only a person may approve; a person approves it.
sentences.paths_unreadable: The files it changes could not be read; a person checks why.
sentences.pause_unreadable: Whether the Factory is paused could not be read; it waits for a person.
sentences.paused: The Factory is paused and does nothing until a person ends the pause.
sentences.proposals_await_owner: The author answered a finding; the reviewer that owns it rules next.
sentences.protected_paths_unreadable: The list of protected files could not be read; a person checks why.
sentences.resolve_due: A reviewer's thread is settled; the Factory resolves it next.
sentences.review_unreadable: A review on it could not be read; a person checks why.
sentences.run_ceiling: It has used every run it is allowed; a person decides whether to renew them.
sentences.run_unidentified: A recent job is not yet matched to its item; the Factory waits before starting another.
sentences.run_unreadable: A run's record could not be read or contradicts itself; a person checks why.
sentences.runs_unnamed: Too many recent jobs are not matched to their items; the Factory waits.
sentences.thread_unreadable: A review thread could not be read; a person checks why.
sentences.timeline_bounded: It is commented on or reviewed past what the Factory reads; a person checks it.
sentences.too_large: It is too large to review whole; a person splits it or closes it.
